title: Körperverletzung und versuchter Raub – wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?

extraction.summaryEn: Three unknown people demanded money from a 30-year-old man on a staircase at Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station, then beat him, one using a glass bottle. He was treated as an outpatient and the trio fled without loot.
